name: Anime Summit
blurb: Brasilia's biggest anime event, mixing Japanese voice-actor and musician guests with cosplay contests, games and tokusatsu programming.
notes: Found a real official site (animesummit.com.br) beyond the given lnk.bio link-in-bio page, now used as url. Its most recent confirmed edition -- the 5th-anniversary show, May 8-10, 2026 at the Museu Nacional da Republica, Brasilia-DF, with guests Feh Dubs (voice actress), singers Mikako Kobayashi and Miura, a Madan Senki Ryukendo cast reunion, streamer Core and band Daruma -- already ran before today (2026-10-05), and the site still frames it as 'nossa ultima edicao' (our latest edition) with no next date posted. The lnk.bio page is even more stale (still showing 'Anime Summit 2024', 18-21 April). An X/Twitter account (@animesummit_) has a bio fragment reading 'Anime Summit 27 a 29 de Setembro', but X blocks fetching (402) so the year and context could not be confirmed, and the Instagram account's recent posts (through Aug 2026) could not be read without login; this is a lead for a future check, not something to report as a confirmed date. Per the no-date-announced rule, editions is left empty; event is annual-ish (running since 2022) so treated as active rather than inactive.
